summary: Embedding channel truncation introduced by proxy causing reranker score collapse and long-tail latency
description: Issue summary: Beginning ~2026-03-10T09:40Z a customer (VectorSearch Inc.) reported sudden and reproducible degradation of rerank quality (many top-k results tied or missing) accompanied by increased long-tail latency and elevated CPU fallback on reranking nodes. Impact: Several production queries returned near-identical scores or empty hits and 95th/99th latency percentiles for rerank calls increased 3-5x, causing downstream timeouts in their search pipeline. Environment: Dedicated tenant running in prod-us-east, routing through an internal L7 proxy introduced last week. Observed vector dimensionality mismatch and network-level truncation correlated with the start time.
steps_to_reproduce: Hit /v1/embeddings endpoint with a known corpus vector payload (1536 dims) via the customer's proxy chain
Forward the resulting embedding to /v1/rerank with candidate set (10 items) and observe topk scores
Compare embedding length at ingress and at reranker service (length logged at both sides)
Replay captured failing request through localhost bypassing proxy to verify behavior changes
logs: Excerpt from reranker logs (2026-03-10T09:42:12): [WARN] Received embedding length 1516 (expected 1536) -> invoking compatibility fallback; computed cosine_norms had near-zero variance; falling back to cpu_sparse_fusion; latency increased from 35ms -> 420ms. API gateway access log (09:41:59) shows upstream response chunk size mismatch and X-Embed-Chunks=3 header set by internal-proxy-v2.
investigation_notes: 03/10 10:00 - Initial triage: Confirmed repro with customer payload. Embedding byte-length shorter by 20 floats (80 bytes).
03/10 11:15 - Packet capture between api-gateway and embeddings-service showed last 80 bytes of payload repeatedly missing when proxy inserted X-Embed-Chunks header.

03/10 12:05 - Review of internal-proxy-v2 changelog found a chunking optimization to split large JSON bodies. Bug in the chunk reassembly code drops trailing chunk when content-length aligns with chunk boundary.

03/10 12:40 - Temporary mitigation: Rolled back internal-proxy-v2 to previous release for routes serving dedicated tenants. Immediate improvement observed for VectorSearch Inc. rerank results and latency returned to normal within 10 minutes.
03/11 09:20 - Deeper root cause: serialization routine in proxy used byte offsets assuming UTF-8 characters; float32 array serialization edge-case caused exact boundary to truncate last 20 elements.
comments: Customer (VectorSearch): 'We started seeing our search quality degrade and timeouts at ~09:40. RAW embeddings in our client are 1536 floats; when we compare hashes earlier to now we see mismatches.'
Support (Sasha): 'Thanks — we've started an investigation and will try to reproduce. Can you provide an example request/response pair and request id?'
SRE (Miguel): 'Reproduced locally. Correlated with proxy deploy. Rolling back proxy for affected routes now.'

Engineering (R&D Lead, Priya Nair): 'Root cause located in internal-proxy-v2 chunk reassembly. PR with fix and unit tests opened: PR-1294. Will add ingress validation to reject unexpected embedding lengths.'
Customer: 'Quality is back to normal after rollback. Please keep us posted on permanent fix and postmortem.'
resolution: Rolled back internal-proxy-v2 on 2026-03-10 12:45Z for the affected routing table. Deployed a patch to ingress that validates embedding vector length against model profile (rejects and logs mismatches with 422). Deployed fix to internal-proxy reassembly logic (PR-1294 merged 2026-03-11) and re-deployed after staging validation. Notified customer and closed with monitoring verification for 24h.
followup_tasks: Add unit/integration tests for proxy chunk reassembly with binary-like JSON payloads (owner: infra-proxy team)
Add embedding-length alert in API gateway (owner: observability)
Add SDK-level client-side validation that warns on unexpected embedding dims (owner: SDK team)
Document defensive ingress checks in runbook and add to postmortem (owner: ops)
Schedule cross-team review of chunking/streaming edge cases with binary arrays in JSON (owner: eng-manager)
monitoring_alert_trigger: New alert 'embedding.length.mismatch' created — fires when >0.5% of embeddings in a 5m window have length != model profile
customer_impact_summary: VectorSearch Inc. experienced degraded rerank quality (missing top-k and tied scores) and increased tail latency for ~45 minutes. No data loss beyond the truncated embeddings; rollback restored normal operation. Customer acknowledged mitigation and accepted postmortem plan.
notes: This ticket differs from prior embedding-dimension issues: root cause was network/proxy chunk reassembly (rather than model-side serialization or quantization). Emphasizes need for considering JSON-encoded numeric arrays as boundary-sensitive payloads when performing chunking at L7.
